photos.title: File:Hudson River Park td (2025-09-18) 054 - Pier 57 Cornerstone.jpg
photos.author: Tdorante10
photos.description: The cornerstone at the south end of the front (inland) face of Pier 57 in the Meatpacking District section of Hudson River Park, at 15th Street and 11th Avenue (West Side Highway) in the Meatpacking District, Chelsea, Manhattan. As evidenced by this cornerstone dated 1952, Pier 57 along with Pier 40 farther south are two of the newest pier buildings to be constructed on the West Side, erected near the end of the heyday of the marine/industrial West Side. Interestingly, both piers remain while many older pier warehouses have been demolished.
